description: Checks whether an RPScripts product (by slug) or your own resource files fit a server: framework (QBCore, Qbox, ESX, vRP, standalone), required resources such as ox_lib, ox_inventory, ox_target or oxmysql, FXServer artifact and game build minimums, OneSync, and conflicts in your resource list. Each check is supported, unsupported or unknown with its evidence; nothing is assumed without a source.

check.description: Resources to check support for, e.g. ["ox_inventory", "ox_target"]

files.description: The resource's text files (fxmanifest.lua, Lua, JS, HTML, JSON …) with paths relative to the resource folder. Nothing is executed.

game_build.description: Enforced GTA V game build, e.g. 3258

server_resources.description: Resources your server starts (names from server.cfg ensure lines)

name: check_compatibility
title: Check FiveM compatibility
